verdict.rationale: Gusto's Embedded Payroll docs show a comprehensive REST API covering payroll runs, off-cycle payrolls, contractor payments, time-off requests, tax configuration, webhooks, idempotency, and pagination — and even ties in AI tooling directly via an official MCP server for Cursor/Windsurf/Claude Desktop, strongly supporting API-native workflows. However, several capabilities (e.g., 401(k) Guideline enrollment, some time-off approval UX, other benefit partner integrations) are explicitly delivered via Gusto's 'pre-built UI Flows' rather than pure API calls, and docs frame API vs. Flows as alternative approaches rather than guaranteeing full parity, so full 1:1 API/UI equivalence isn't confirmed.
